Rest-Pause.scheme: Hard set in target range → 15–30 sec → extra reps → 15–30 sec → extra reps
Rest-Pause.compare: More reps with the same load in less time • moderate-high fatigue

DC Rest-Pause.compare: Very dense effort • aggressive fatigue • compare total RP reps

Myo-Reps.scheme: Activation 12–20 @ ~1–2 RIR → 10–20 sec → mini-sets of ~4 reps until quality drops
Myo-Reps.compare: High effective-rep density • compare activation + mini-set total

FST-7.compare: Pump/density method • compare load + completed reps across all 7

Widowmaker.compare: Single high-rep continuous effort • compare load × reps

BFR.scheme: Light load • 30 reps, then 3 × 15 with short rests
BFR.compare: Low-load metabolic work • do not compare load directly with straight sets

Lengthened Partials.scheme: Full-ROM reps near the target effort → 2–5 controlled partials in the lengthened range
Lengthened Partials.compare: Compare full-ROM reps and partials separately; do not call partials full reps

Mechanical Drop Set.scheme: Hard set → easier leverage/variation → optional final easier leverage, with minimal transition time
Mechanical Drop Set.compare: Compare the same mechanical sequence; do not treat stages as one continuous exercise record
